CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_timeline_post AS
SELECT

    CASE WHEN broadcast.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS potd,
    CASE WHEN broadcast.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_build_object('title', broadcast.title, 'message', broadcast.messages) ELSE NULL END AS broadcast_data,
    posts.is_processing, posts.visibility,
    (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id',          a.id,
        'title',       a.title,
        'url',         a.url,
        'description', a.description,
        'cta_text',    a.cta_text,
        'category_id', a.category_id
      ) FROM panorra_dev.public.affiliate a WHERE a.id = posts.affiliate_id) AS affiliate,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'sequence',    ph.sequence,
                 'type',        ph.type,
                 'coordinates', ph.coordinates,
                 'data',        ph.data
               ) ORDER BY ph.sequence ASC
             )
      FROM panorra_dev.public.post_hotspots ph
      WHERE ph.post_id = posts.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS hotspot
FROM panorra_dev.public.posts
LEFT JOIN panorra_dev.public.users ON users.id = posts.user_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id) post_id, title, messages FROM panorra_dev.public.broadcast ORDER BY post_id, created_at DESC) AS broadcast ON broadcast.post_id = posts.id
WHERE ((posts.is_publish = true) AND (posts.banned = false)) AND (users.banned = false)
GROUP BY
    posts.category_id, posts.created_at, posts.animation, posts.animation_filter, posts.description, posts.slug, posts.little_planet, posts.little_planet_filter, posts.location_post, posts.location_name, posts.panorama, posts.thumbnail, posts.panorama_preview, posts.post_type, posts.panorama_quality, posts.pending, posts.score_mostpopular, posts.score_timeline, posts.user_id, users.avatar, users.fullname, users.username, users.encrypt, broadcast.post_id, broadcast.messages, broadcast.title, posts.is_processing, posts.visibility,
    posts.affiliate_id, posts.id;
